import.method: git archive --format=tar HEAD from the pinned detached checkout, extracted verbatim; no export-ignore, no submodules, no symlinks, no LFS pointers in this tree

Size llama.cpp embedding contexts to the truncated batch, cap parallel contexts using estimated resource requirements and an explicit memory budget, release contexts on demand, and serialize batches on one model so a resize cannot dispose contexts another batch is reading.

rules: The import commit is upstream verbatim. Every later change is a separate commit and a local_patches entry.
A local_patches entry records original_blob, resulting_blob, reason and test evidence.
Distribution artefacts (npm tarball, PyPI wheel) are never a substitute for this source.
added_files_note: Files lazy-intel adds inside the vendor tree. They are ours, not upstream's, and carry an ADDED BY lazy-intel header. verify-vendor.mjs accepts exactly these as non-drift.
